meaning: Let f be a first mover moved by none. Lambda.7's mover m moves something and is moved in no respect, so it is a first mover moved by none, and by uniqueness f = m; so f cannot be otherwise in any respect. If f were in potency in a respect r, it could fail to be r (potency of the contradictory), hence could be otherwise in r (bridge), which is excluded. So f is in potency in no respect.
